name: save-boot-11a-stats-battle-limit
description: #130: g_BattleWork.party[i].limitBar is the battle's copy of each slot's limit bar. From "stats-battle", wait until party[0].limitBar reads Cloud's described limit bar (100; lim_wait = frames until battle init copies it, 0 on a timeout, which stops the script), then on the same frame: party[1] reads Barret's (50; lim1_ok) and party[2] Tifa's (200; lim2_ok); the high byte of g_ActiveCharacters[i].unk1A holds the same values (act_lim: slot 0's metric, slots 1-2 count towards pass/fail); g_ActiveCharacters[i].mp still equals the described MP (mp_battle, same rule). Attempt 1 ruled out the other documented base, 0x800F5BBC (it never read 100). 1/0 and frame counts only. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.
